products.name: Dog/Cat Water Dispenser
products.descriptionHtml:
(UPDATED Reduced size and price! It became infeasible to ship the larger size. New size is 9” long, 5” wide, and 5” tall)

I became sick and tired always refilling our beloved pups water bowl, and I wasn’t happy with the “junky” modular options out there. So…I designed my own from scratch. I wanted a narrow foot print to fit next to her food dish, and to not take up too much space. I wanted something that can hold a few days worth of water. I wanted something that was robust and sturdy (thick walled construction). I also wanted something that looked good too!
Each item takes nearly a day or two to produce, and if I don’t have a color that you want listed, just ask…I can get that for you!

Please keep in mind to rinse out the bowl weekly with lukewarm water and occasionally use a mild soap like dawn, and rinse thoroughly. DO NOT USE HOT WATER or DISHWASHER. It WILL wreck the item permanently. Also, because this is plastic, for the sake of you best friend…consider replacing yearly to keep mold from ever getting a chance to take hold!

Thanks for supporting a product designed and manufactured here in the great Badger State!

The Milk Crate! Finally a solution for actually being able to be HANDS FREE while using the Medela Freestyle!

products.descriptionHtml:
This listing is for a replacement water reservoir cover (cap/lid) for the Nespresso Inissia Espresso Machine by De’Longh.

Attach the cover by placing the stationary pin of the cover in the small hole on the top of the water tank, and then slide the other “movable” pin into the opposite small hole, and it should “click” in place. If you ever need to remove the cover, simply use a pen tip to push out the “movable” pin and you can lift the cover off the water reservoir once the pin clears the width of the wall of the water reservoir.

PLEASE NOTE!!!
The factory covers have two small hooks that are supposed to help hold the water reservoir in place. We have found these hooks to be too small to successfully 3D print. We have decided to just use two small nubs that help the reservoir not shift side to side, and the pegs on the coffee machine hold the tank JUST FINE. We just wanted you to be aware of this design decision, and please know the cover will work as intended!!!

WARNING…NOT DISHWASHER SAFE! HAND WASH ONLY PLEASE! 😁

Thank you!

products.name: Nespresso Vertuo Capsule Recycler with Metal Blade Foil Cutter.
products.descriptionHtml:
We love coffee, hence the reason why we got a Vertuo. Pods can get expensive, so why not refill the aluminum cups with some good local beans? Well, with this “recycler” you can.

Includes the original plastic pod cutter with storage ring for free. Optional cutter with all metal blades available for just a few more dollars.


Free sheet of foil lids with every purchase!

WARNING…NOT DISHWASHER SAFE! HAND WASH ONLY PLEASE! 😁

Note: you do not use this in the coffee maker! This helps you refill previously used pods.

Double Note: Hope it goes without saying but the used coffee pod is NOT included with this kit. Please provide your own coffee before beginning! ;)

How to use:

1. Use the cutter ring to open up a Nespresso vertuo pod.

2. Discard contents of old coffee.

3. Place pod in the Recycler’s stand.

4. Take a piece of aluminum foil (regular duty) (or use a pre made foil lid from Amazon- 4 free included with each purchase)and fold it over so you have a double layer of foil large enough to completely cover the pod. (Found the regular aluminum foil doubled up worked better than heavy duty to hold up to pressure of the brew, but feel free to experiment!) Place the aluminum foil over the pod and use the topper to press down, crimping the aluminum foil to the pod.

5. Trim excess aluminum foil from around the coffee pod in stand being careful not to fold the foil over the lip of the pod and cover up the barcode. That barcode is essential for the coffee maker to run, and if it’s covered the brew won’t cycle. Keep pressure on the topper while you trim to avoid pulling up the aluminum foil.

6. Remove pod from stand, and place pod in maker (not too roughly mind you) and just keep an eye on it while it closes to make sure the pod sits nicely in its spot.

7. Brew and Enjoy!!!

Repeat over and over again.

Will save tons of money in the long run!

Thanks for looking! :)

(Right now they are black/gray, but the color can change from time to time, and if you have a specific color in mind shoot me a message and we can work something out!)
